tasks.analysis: Supply and demand are fundamental concepts in economics because they determine the price and availability of goods or services. When there is more demand for a product, suppliers may make it more expensive to increase profits. Conversely, an excess supply can lead to price reductions. Market equilibrium occurs when supply matches demand, resulting in stable prices. The real world, however, is rarely as simple as this.
